No. Of the 81.3 hectares of mapped 2021 tree-cover loss, 68.1 hectares overlapped mapped pine plantation and 13.2 hectares were outside mapped forest. None overlapped mapped native forest.

The mapping does not establish the cause of the loss or whether the area outside mapped forest was actually non-forest. A further 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in patches under 0.5 hectares and was not counted as an event; its forest-type breakdown is not provided.
